canon_ref.note: The same morning Ryoka arrives. The three captains who walk out (Gregor, Menes, Rois) are not NPCs. Cervial rode a day from Liscor. Ceria later wins him over (1.48R).

b1.captains_plan_the_ruins_raid.summary: Six Silver-rank captains meet in Esthelm. Calruz and Yvlon Byres want a joint raid on the ruins near Liscor before a Gold-rank team arrives within the week. Charlez's team came back as zombies, and Gazi of Reim waits in Liscor, so three captains walk out. Cervial will join if Ceria agrees.
